pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular dark brown polygonal regions with sharp edge gradients; significant portions of the internal patch area exhibit raised, rugose textural elevations and nodular disruption.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Narrow, cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous reticular graph with high-connectivity junction nodes; line thickness remains relatively uniform across the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible along the upper right neck-shoulder transition; displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette consistent with a short mane.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Extensive distribution of raised, hyper-pigmented, and granular nodular masses concentrated along the dorsal ridge and radiating down the upper flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Diffuse, severe nodular skin lesions across the upper torso; presence of two avian organisms (oxpeckers) perched on the dorsal ridge near the shoulder and mid-back.
